title: Yara and the Visitor
author: Rafael Villalobos
blurb: Isandro Hartwell, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the well refills.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
